Book a public night

Two hours at the 60 cm telescope with an astronomer. €6 a person, paid at the door.

See you on the hill

Doors open at 19:30. If the sky closes, we email you at 17:00 and your places move to the next clear Friday. Dress for a cold dome.

Privacy

What we keep, and why

This site sets no cookies and runs no trackers. The fonts come from Google Fonts.

For a booking we keep your name and email until the night is over - to send the cloud warning at 17:00 - and delete them the week after. We never pass them on.

Questions or a request to delete: privacy@example.com
